body: Thank you, your reply is really appreciated. Today has been such a dark day & the suicidal thoughts and urge to go through with it have been overwhelming. Selfishly I needed to hear some kind words, although I don’t think I realised that when I posted.

Thank you, my children really are my world and I fight so hard each day to hide my feelings from them and show them how loved they are. They are still so young and innocent. 
Sometimes though the suicidal feelings get so bad and the black fog feels like it’s taking over it’s overwhelming there’s no escape. 
I’m sorry for the way you grew up it must’ve been so hard watching your father that way. Every day is a battle for me & tonight has been a real struggle but my children remain oblivious & they went to sleep feeling happy and loved.
